'''Cliffside Compound''' was a type of real estate property on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]], available on the [[Stronghold directory terminal|Stronghold market]] during the [[Inter-Sith Wars period]].<ref name="TOR">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''</ref>

{{Loc-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
The Cliffside Compound is the Tatooine stronghold introduced in the expansion ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Galactic Strongholds]]''.
